# apple_retention_messages (Data Source)

Lists an app's retention messages.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_retention_messages" "app" {
  app_id = data.apple_app.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the app.

### Read-Only

- `retention_messages` (Attributes List) The retention messages. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retention_messages))

<a id="nestedatt--retention_messages"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retention_messages`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the retention message.
- `reference_name` (String) Reference name of the message.
